decisionBoundary.rule: This record approves limited behavioral defaults only; each owner issue still requires its own Ready status, approved design, implementation evidence, review and acceptance.

decisions.approvedDefault: On the native button path, generate aria-pressed=true/false only when Toggled.HasValue; omit when null; preserve unrelated caller attributes.
openDetails: Explicit caller-supplied aria-pressed precedence remains unresolved.
Do not change link/navigation semantics by inferring toggle semantics.

decisions.approvedDefault: For MaxFiles > 1, reject the entire new picker batch if it exceeds aggregate remaining capacity, preserve previously accepted files, and show localized accessible validation feedback.
openDetails: Filename-specific remove-button name and focus edge cases.
MaxFiles=1 is a compatibility expectation to verify, not a separately approved new policy.

decisions.approvedDefault: Use PointerEventArgs.ClientX with the matching getBoundingClientRect().Left; adjust for half the thumb width, clamp normalized position to [0,1], and guard degenerate geometry.
openDetails: Accepted component design and native verification.

decisions.approvedDefault: Use two independently accessible thumbs with stable non-crossing endpoints; classify this as a Bluent-specific two-thumb extension, not one-to-one Fluent Web Components parity.
openDetails: Accessible names, keyboard order and dependent ARIA bounds.
Accepted component design and native verification.

decisions.approvedDefault: Use semantic track/selection roles and a solid system-color fallback that remains visible in forced-colors mode.
openDetails: Native Windows Contrast Themes and assistive-technology review.
